title: Insecure deserialization in notification service allows remote code execution
description: The notification service deserializes untrusted payloads from crafted operator documents without type filtering, allowing an attacker to run arbitrary code once the document is opened.
remediation_plan: Enable a deserialization allow-list and upgrade the notification module to the patched release.

title: Unauthenticated command injection in perimeter firewall VPN portal
description: A command injection flaw in the VPN portal of the perimeter firewall lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute operating system commands with root privileges.
remediation_plan: Upgrade the firewall firmware to the fixed release and enable the vendor threat-prevention signature.

title: Signal handler race condition in SSH daemon enables remote root code execution
description: A race condition in the signal handler of the SSH daemon allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
remediation_plan: Update the SSH server package to the fixed version or set LoginGraceTime to 0 as a temporary mitigation.

title: Rapid stream reset flood causes denial of service in HTTP/2 reverse proxy
description: The HTTP/2 implementation accepts rapid consecutive stream resets from a client, exhausting worker resources and causing a denial of service.
remediation_plan: Configure HTTP/2 stream rate-limiting in reverse proxies and patch load balancers.

title: Arbitrary file read through argument expansion in CI server command line interface
description: The command line interface of the CI server expands file references in arguments, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files from the server.
remediation_plan: Upgrade the CI server core to the fixed version and disable unauthenticated command line access.

title: Authentication bypass in CI server web console grants administrative access
description: An authentication bypass in the web console of the CI server enables unauthenticated remote attackers to perform administrative actions and achieve code execution.
remediation_plan: Apply the vendor security release and rotate build agent tokens.

title: Argument injection in legacy report CGI handler allows command execution
description: The legacy CGI handler of the reporting module passes query string characters to the interpreter without sanitization, allowing remote command execution.
remediation_plan: Update the interpreter to the fixed release and migrate legacy CGI handlers to FastCGI.

title: Heap overflow in directory licensing RPC service allows unauthenticated code execution
description: A heap-based buffer overflow in the licensing RPC service of the directory server allows unauthenticated network attackers to achieve code execution.
remediation_plan: Install the cumulative security update on domain controllers and restrict RPC port exposure.

title: Heap buffer overflow in image decoding library triggered by crafted upload
description: A heap buffer overflow in the lossless image decoder allows code execution when a crafted image uploaded by a user is rendered.
remediation_plan: Update the system image decoding library across web portal nodes.

title: Container escape through leaked file descriptor in container runtime
description: The container runtime leaks an internal host file descriptor when a crafted working directory is specified, allowing a container breakout to the host.
remediation_plan: Upgrade the container runtime on Kubernetes payment and core nodes to the fixed release.

title: Backdoor injected into compression library release tarball
description: Upstream source tarballs of a widely used compression library contained obfuscated backdoor code that altered authentication functions during the build stage.
remediation_plan: Pin the library to verified clean packages and audit cryptographic checksums.

title: Ejecución remota de código (RCE) por escritura fuera de límites en pasarela API de pagos
description: Vulnerabilidad crítica de escritura fuera de límites (Out-of-bounds Write) en el motor TLS/HTTP de la API de pagos alojada por HostingSur S.L., permitiendo ejecución de código arbitrario mediante peticiones HTTP manipuladas sin autenticación previa.
remediation_plan: Aplicar parche de emergencia en el cluster de API de pagos de HostingSur S.L., activar reglas WAF de inspección profunda y condicionar la renovación del contrato de marzo a la verificación del parche.

title: Denial of service in firewall web management engine
description: A flaw in the web management engine of the firewall allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to reload the device, causing a denial of service.
remediation_plan: Apply the fixed firewall software release during the scheduled maintenance window.

title: Heap buffer overflow in proxy client library SOCKS5 handshake
description: A heap-based buffer overflow in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake of the client library allows remote code execution or a crash when hostnames exceed 255 bytes.
remediation_plan: Update the client library across all Debian and Ubuntu base images.

title: URL parsing flaw in web framework enables open redirect and SSRF
description: Applications that build URLs from externally provided host information may parse them insecurely in the web framework, enabling open redirects and server-side request forgery.
remediation_plan: Upgrade the web framework to the fixed version and validate redirect targets against an allow-list.

title: Memory exhaustion in archive library when processing crafted archives
description: The archive library allocates resources without limits, so a crafted archive file can cause an out-of-memory error and degrade the service.
remediation_plan: Update the archive library dependency to the fixed release in the Maven build.

title: Compressed token bomb exhausts server resources in token library
description: An attacker can send a highly compressed encrypted token that exhausts CPU and memory on the server when it is decompressed.
remediation_plan: Update the token library and enforce a 256 KB decompression cap on token payloads.

title: Inconsistent IPv4-mapped IPv6 parsing allows access control list bypass
description: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are parsed inconsistently by the address helper functions, which could cause access control list bypasses.
remediation_plan: Recompile the affected microservices with the fixed runtime release.

title: Integer overflow in legacy archive utility
description: A legacy archive utility contains an integer overflow that can lead to a limited heap buffer overflow when a large uncompressed file size is supplied.
remediation_plan: Replace the legacy archive routines with standard Java or operating system zip libraries.

title: Path traversal in static resource handler for authenticated users
description: Applications serving static resources through custom resource chain resolvers could expose limited internal files to authenticated users.
remediation_plan: Update the web framework to the fixed release and audit the resource handler configuration.
